summary.zh: 分轮打磨现有文案，兼顾清晰度、语气与可读性
summary.en: Polish existing copy in focused passes for clarity, voice and flow

description.zh: 对已有页面、邮件或广告文案做多轮精修，分别处理清晰度、语气一致性、具体性和可读性，并清理明显的 AI 腔调。适合发布前润色，或改写冗长含糊的段落。
description.en: Edits existing pages, emails and ads in separate passes for clarity, voice, specificity and readability, and strips out telltale AI phrasing. Good for a final polish or for tightening wordy sections.
